option_relations.rationale: The option describes a different type of lymphoma (CLL/SLL) which is not directly related to the provided leaf.
Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma (DLBCL) is a broader category that includes Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
CD5-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is a subtype of DLBCL, which is a broader category that includes Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
Richter's transformation is a specific event in CLL/SLL, which is not directly related to the provided leaf of Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
